# Data Preprocessing
```{r data_preprocess}
# load in function
source("Functions/Function_run_lmer.R")

# set paths
dataPath <- "../../3_Data/exp3/CleanData/"

# load in data
data_all <- read.csv(file = file.path(dataPath, "data_all.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # R uses the first factor level as reference (0) for dummy‑variable coding
    association = factor(association, levels = c("self", "other")),
    task_type = factor(task_type, levels = c("overlap", "relevant", "irrelevant"))
)

data_all$rt <- data_all$rt * 1000

# data_all$task_type <- factor(data_all$task_type)
# data_all$task_type <- relevel(data_all$task_type, ref = "relevant")
```



# 1 Test Hypothesis 1 (association * task‑type interaction)
## 1.1 RT
### 1. Model Fitting
```{r warning=FALSE}
m1_rt <- data_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(correct == 1) %>%
  brms::brm(
    rt ~ association*task_type + (1 + association*task_type|subj_idx),
    data = ., 
    family=lognormal(),
    prior = prior(normal(0, 3), class = b),
    chains = 4,   
    warmup = 500,  
    iter = 2000,  
    thin = 1, 
    sample_prior = "yes",
    control = list(adapt_delta = .95),
    cores = parallel::detectCores(),
    backend = 'cmdstanr',
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    file = file.path(curDir, "glmmModels/m1_rt") 
)
```

### 2. Model Evaluation
```{r}
summary(m1_rt)
```

### 3. Posterior Predictive Check
```{r}
pp_check(m1_rt, type = "dens_overlay") +papaja::theme_apa()
```

### 4. Statistical Inference

```{r}
# Population‑level fixed effects: reaction‑time distribution for each condition
df_rt_pop <- m1_rt %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(`b_.*`, regex = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(term = .variable,
                pop_mean = .value) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term = gsub("b_", "", term))%>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(term), values_from = pop_mean) %>%   # long to wide
  # Compute predicted RT distribution for each experimental condition
  dplyr::mutate(
    self_overlap = Intercept,   # self and overlap set as reference baseline
    other_overlap = Intercept  + associationother,
    self_irrelevant = Intercept  + task_typeirrelevant,
    other_irrelevant = Intercept  + task_typeirrelevant + associationother +`associationother:task_typeirrelevant` ,
    self_relevant = Intercept  + task_typerelevant,
    other_relevant = Intercept + associationother + task_typerelevant + `associationother:task_typerelevant`
    )%>%
  dplyr::select(`.chain`, `.iteration`, `.draw`,
                self_overlap, other_overlap,
                self_irrelevant, other_irrelevant,
                self_relevant, other_relevant) %>%
  # wide to long
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = self_overlap:other_relevant, names_to = "term", values_to =  "value") %>%  
  dplyr::mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c(
    'self_overlap', 'other_overlap', 
    'self_irrelevant', 'other_irrelevant', 
    'self_relevant', 'other_relevant'
  )),
  # Back‑transform from log scale
  value = exp(value))
  # value = value *1000)

df_rt_pop
```

```{r}
# Population‑level fixed effects: posterior distribution of condition differences
df_rt_pop_diff_wide <- df_rt_pop %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(term), values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    diff_os_overlap = other_overlap - self_overlap,
    diff_os_irrelevant = other_irrelevant - self_irrelevant,
    diff_os_relevant = other_relevant - self_relevant
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(`.chain`, `.iteration`, `.draw`, diff_os_overlap,
    diff_os_irrelevant, diff_os_relevant)

df_rt_pop_diff_wide
```

```{r}
# Population‑level fixed effects: posterior‑distribution summary statistics
df_rt_fixed <- df_rt_pop%>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(.,
                     id_cols = c('.chain', '.iteration', '.draw'),
                     names_from = term ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c('.chain', '.iteration', '.draw')) %>%
  bayestestR::describe_posterior(.,
                                 ci = 0.95,
                                 ci_method = 'hdi',
                                 test = c("p_direction", "p_significance"),
                                 centrality = "median") %>%
  tidyr::separate(Parameter, c('association', 'task_type')) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(association = factor(association, levels = c('self', 'other')),
                task_type = factor(task_type, levels = c('overlap','irrelevant', 'relevant')))

summary(df_rt_fixed)
```


```{r}
# Statistical inference using the sexit framework
bayestestR::sexit(df_rt_pop_diff_wide[,c(4:6)])
```

```{r}
# Compute Bayes factors
# identity-choice task
hyp_choice <- hypothesis(m1_rt, "associationother = 0")
BF01_choice <- hyp_choice$hypothesis$Evid.Ratio
BF10_choice <- 1 / BF01_choice
print(BF10_choice)

# id-televant task
hyp_relevant <- hypothesis(m1_rt, "associationother + associationother:task_typerelevant = 0")
BF01_relevant <- hyp_relevant$hypothesis$Evid.Ratio
BF10_relevant <- 1 / BF01_relevant
print(BF10_relevant)

# id-irrelevant task
hyp_irrelevant <- hypothesis(m1_rt, "associationother + associationother:task_typeirrelevant = 0")
BF01_irrelevant <- hyp_irrelevant$hypothesis$Evid.Ratio
BF10_irrelevant <- 1 / BF01_irrelevant
print(BF10_irrelevant)
```

### 4. Statistical Inference

```{r}
newdata <- expand.grid(
  association = levels(factor(data_all$association)),
  task_type   = levels(factor(data_all$task_type))
)

# population-level
draws <- newdata %>%
  add_epred_draws(m2_acc, re_formula = NA)


diff_draws <- draws %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(.draw, task_type, association, .epred) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = association,
    values_from = .epred
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_self_other = self - other   
  )

diff_summary <- diff_draws %>%
  group_by(task_type) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(diff_self_other),
    lower  = quantile(diff_self_other, 0.025),
    upper  = quantile(diff_self_other, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_pct = median * 100,
    lower_pct  = lower * 100,
    upper_pct  = upper * 100
  )

diff_summary
```
```{r}
newdata <- expand.grid(
  association = levels(factor(data_all$association)),
  task_type   = levels(factor(data_all$task_type))
)

draws <- newdata %>%
  add_epred_draws(m2_acc, re_formula = NA)

# Compute diff_self_other while retaining .chain and .iteration
diff_draws <- draws %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(.chain, .iteration, .draw, task_type, association, .epred) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = association,
    values_from = .epred
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_self_other = self - other 
  ) %>%
  select(.chain, .iteration, .draw, task_type, diff_self_other) 

# Reshape task_type into wide format with prefix
df_acc_pop_diff_wide <- diff_draws %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = task_type,
    values_from = diff_self_other,
    names_prefix = "diff_so_" 
  )


df_acc_pop_diff_wide
```

```{r}
# Population‑level fixed effects: condition‑wise response distribution
df_acc_pop <- m2_acc %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(`b_.*`, regex = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(term = .variable,
                pop_mean = .value) %>%  
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term = gsub("b_", "", term))%>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(term), values_from = pop_mean) %>%   # long to wide
  # Calculate model predictions for each condition
  dplyr::mutate(
    self_overlap = Intercept, 
    other_overlap = Intercept  + associationother,
    self_irrelevant = Intercept  + task_typeirrelevant,
    other_irrelevant = Intercept  + task_typeirrelevant + associationother +`associationother:task_typeirrelevant` ,
    self_relevant = Intercept  + task_typerelevant,
    other_relevant = Intercept + associationother + task_typerelevant + `associationother:task_typerelevant`
    )%>%
  dplyr::select(`.chain`, `.iteration`, `.draw`,
                self_overlap, other_overlap,
                self_irrelevant, other_irrelevant,
                self_relevant, other_relevant) %>%
  # wide to long
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = self_overlap:other_relevant, names_to = "term", values_to =  "value") %>%  
  dplyr::mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c(
    'self_overlap', 'other_overlap', 
    'self_irrelevant', 'other_irrelevant', 
    'self_relevant', 'other_relevant'
  )))

df_acc_pop
```

## 1.3 Result Visualization

```{r}
df_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_shape_rt_acc, data_color_rt_acc)
# ==================================================
# Data preprocessing
# ==================================================
# ---- RT difference data（other - self） ----
df_rt_pop_diff <- df_rt_pop_diff_wide %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = diff_os_overlap:diff_os_relevant,
    names_to = "term_diff",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_diff = factor(
      term_diff,
      levels = c("diff_os_overlap", "diff_os_relevant", "diff_os_irrelevant"),
      labels = c("identity-choice", "identity-relevant", "identity-irrelevant")
    )
  )

# ---- ACC difference data（self - other） ----
df_acc_pop_diff <- df_acc_pop_diff_wide %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = diff_so_overlap:diff_so_irrelevant,
    names_to = "term_diff",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_diff = factor(
      term_diff,
      levels = c("diff_so_overlap", "diff_so_relevant", "diff_so_irrelevant"),
      labels = c("identity-choice", "identity-relevant", "identity-irrelevant")
    )
  )

# ---- Raw behavioral dataset ----
df_behavior_long <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(part %in% c("RDK_shape","RDK_color","RDK_overlap")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    disc_layer = dplyr::case_when(
      group == "shape" & part == "RDK_shape" ~ "identity-relevant",
      group == "shape" & part == "RDK_color" ~ "identity-irrelevant",
      group == "color" & part == "RDK_color" ~ "identity-relevant",
      group == "color" & part == "RDK_shape" ~ "identity-irrelevant",
      part == "RDK_overlap" ~ "identity-choice",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(disc_layer) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    disc_layer = factor(disc_layer,
                        levels = c("identity-choice", "identity-relevant", "identity-irrelevant"))
  )

# ==================================================
# Color palette definition
# ==================================================
fill_palette_left   <- c("other" = "#A0C0D8", "self" = "#F0A8A8")
colour_palette_left <- c("other" = "#3A6B8C", "self" = "#C84848")

fill_palette_right <- c("TRUE" = "#C9A6D9", "FALSE" = "#96C7C9")
line_col_right     <- "#5D3A7A"

# Global plotting parameters
dodge_width <- 0.75
slab_height <- 0.65
y_expand <- 0.9

# ==================================================
# Raw RT distribution
# ==================================================
p_rt_raw <- df_behavior_long %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = rt, y = disc_layer, fill = association)) +
  ggdist::stat_slab(
    orientation = "horizontal",
    adjust = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6,
    side = "top",
    height = slab_height,
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.12,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette_left) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = colour_palette_left) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(y_expand, y_expand))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "RT (ms)", y = "", tag = "a") +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::unit(c(1,1,0.5,0.2), "cm"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, margin = ggplot2::margin(t=8)),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size=14),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size=15),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust=0, vjust=1),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

# ==================================================
# Posterior distribution of RT differences
# ==================================================
p_rt_diff <- df_rt_pop_diff %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = value,
      y = term_diff,
      fill = ggplot2::after_stat(x > 0)
    )
  ) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(
    orientation = "horizontal",
    .height = slab_height,
    adjust = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.8,
    interval_color = line_col_right,
    point_color = line_col_right
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = fill_palette_right,
    breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    name = "Difference",
    labels = c("> 0 (self advantage)", "< 0 (other advantage)")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(y_expand, y_expand))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "RT difference (other - self, ms)",
    y = "",
    tag = "c"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::unit(c(1, 0.2, 0.5, 1), "cm"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0, vjust = 1),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

# ==================================================
# Raw Accuracy distribution
# ==================================================
p_acc_raw <- df_behavior_long %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = acc, y = disc_layer, fill = association)) +
  ggdist::stat_slab(
    orientation = "horizontal",
    adjust = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6,
    side = "top",
    height = slab_height,
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.12,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette_left) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = colour_palette_left) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(y_expand, y_expand))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Accuracy", y = "", tag = "b") +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::unit(c(0.5,1,1,0.2), "cm"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size =16, margin = ggplot2::margin(t=8)),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size=14),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size=15),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust=0, vjust=1),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

# ==================================================
# Posterior distribution of ACC differences
# ==================================================
p_acc_diff <- df_acc_pop_diff %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = value,
      y = term_diff,
      fill = ggplot2::after_stat(x > 0)
    )
  ) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(
    orientation = "horizontal",
    .height = slab_height,
    adjust = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.8,
    interval_color = line_col_right,
    point_color = line_col_right
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = fill_palette_right,
    breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    name = "Difference",
    labels = c("> 0 (self advantage)", "< 0 (other advantage)")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(y_expand, y_expand))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "ACC difference (self - other)",
    y = "",
    tag = "d"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::unit(c(0.5,0.2,1,1), "cm"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0, vjust = 1),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

# ==================================================
# Assemble subplots & collect single global legend
# ==================================================
fig_combined <- p_rt_raw + p_rt_diff +
  p_acc_raw + p_acc_diff +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
    widths = c(1.1, 0.9),
    heights = c(1, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13),
    legend.key.size = ggplot2::unit(0.6, "cm")
  )

print(fig_combined)

ggsave("fig2_behavior.png", fig_combined, width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
